title: Resume an Engineering Graph with --rerun and re-execute only that node and its descendants
task: Engineering Graph control plane: after the graph passes, resuming with a rerun of one node must invalidate that node and every descendant while every ancestor keeps its settled result.

nodes.task: `npm test` fails in this project. `chunk` in src/chunk.js drops the trailing partial window because its loop only emits full `size` slices. Fix src/chunk.js so the remainder is returned as a final shorter chunk and an input shorter than `size` yields one chunk. Do NOT edit anything under test/. Run `npm test` to verify.

notes: The first invocation must reach "passed" on its own; the second resumes the same persisted checkpoint with rerunFrom=[package]. verify-graph.mjs counts node.completed events per node from the retained lifecycle window: the Agent ancestor exactly once, the reran node and its descendant exactly twice. That distinguishes a real scoped invalidation from either a no-op resume or a full replay.
